FROM_CONVERSATIONS.HERO_TITLE: Who do you want to find in your conversations?
FROM_CONVERSATIONS.HERO_TEXT: Write it your way. We read the conversations and bring you the list to check before saving.

FROM_CONVERSATIONS.PERIOD_EMPTY: There are no conversations in this period

FROM_CONVERSATIONS.NO_KEY_TEXT: The search uses your own account's AI and the cost stays there. It takes 2 minutes to connect.
FROM_CONVERSATIONS.NO_KEY_ASK_ADMIN: The search uses your own account's AI. Ask an administrator to connect it.
FROM_CONVERSATIONS.COST_PROMISE: You only pay if you press "Start searching". If it reaches {max}, the search stops and asks before spending more.

FROM_CONVERSATIONS.STOP: Stop and see who we found

FROM_CONVERSATIONS.NOBODY_TEXT: I read {read} conversations (it cost {brl}) and nobody matched. Try a longer period or write the request another way.

PROVAVEL.TITLE: Likely
PROVAVEL.HINT: Everything points to yes, but a detail is missing. They are in the list: take out whoever you do not want.

FORA.TITLE: Outside the rule
FORA.HINT: They do not follow the rule, or the conversation was not clear. They start out: add one by one whoever you want.

FROM_CONVERSATIONS.OUT_TITLE: Will not receive, even following the rule:

FROM_CONVERSATIONS.PEEK_WHY_ADDED: Outside the rule · you added them
